authors: Leslie M. Connaughton, I. Peter Hershey, Frank J. Millero
title: PVT Properties of Concentrated Aqueous Electrolytes: V. Densities and Apparent Molal Volumes of the Four Major Sea Salts from Dilute Solution to Saturation and from 0 to 100 C
experimental_method: Densities of NaCl, Na2SO4, MgCl2 and MgSO4 solutions measured from 35 to 95 C (10 K steps) with a Mettler/Paar vibrating-tube densimeter (Picker flow densimeter at 25 C), calibrated with water, standard seawater and nitrogen; molalities fixed from 25 C densities of the degassed stock solutions.
uncertainties_stated: Independent 25 C density checks agree within +-20x10^-6 g cm^-3; temperature control +-0.002 to 0.01 C; standard deviations of the fitted density equations 43, 55, 45 and 53 x10^-6 g cm^-3 for NaCl, Na2SO4, MgCl2, MgSO4. No per-point uncertainty.
quality_remarks: Table I lists density differences from pure water (10^3 Delta d, g cm^-3), not densities; the water densities are from Kell. Molalities of the stock solutions were obtained by iterating the 25 C density equations of state, so molality is derived from density. As printed, MgCl2 at 75 C, m = 4.48055 has 10^3 Delta d = 226.818, equal to the value for m = 3.50112 at the same temperature and lower than the value at m = 3.98681 (252.557): almost certainly a misprint, kept as printed. The text layer carried several single-digit errors (e.g. 168.154 for 68.154 and 160.980 for 60.980) that the page image showed to be extraction errors, not misprints. Tables II-V (fit coefficients, Pitzer coefficients, apparent molal volumes at infinite dilution) are fitted or derived and not extracted. Data at 35-95 C only; the paper's equations also use literature data and the authors' earlier measurements, which are not tabulated here.
how_extracted: pdf_text_layer (character-level OCR layer, parsed with pdftotext -bbox and grouped by column/block with a script), then every page image (PDF pages 4-6) was read and compared
not_extracted_tables: Table II: coefficients of the density-difference fit (model parameters)
Table III: Pitzer coefficients for specific volumes, Float method (fitted)
Table IV: Pitzer coefficients, Fix method (fitted)
Table V: infinite-dilution apparent molal volumes calculated from fitted coefficients (derived)
extraction_notes: One CSV per salt (table_1_group1..4 = NaCl, Na2SO4, MgCl2, MgSO4) so that each mapping has one salt in per_row; each temperature block is introduced by a label row (e.g. '35 C') listed in skip_rows and in group_rows, which sets T.constant. Blocks that run over from one printed column into the next (e.g. NaCl 45 C, 65 C, 75 C) are joined into one block. The printed layout repeats the temperature sub-heading at the top of the continued column for the 45 C NaCl block; written once. Sanity checks (script): m and 10^3 Delta d increase monotonically within every block except the MgCl2 75 C last row (see quality_remarks); no duplicate m within a block; row counts per block equal the printed counts in the image. Comma decimals produced by the scan layer were read as full stops (see changes list).
needs_pass2_reason: the text layer is a low-quality OCR layer and 48 cells needed correction after the image check
